description: Geodata of Damage Assessment of Sana'a International Airport, Sana'a Governorate, Yemen is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). This map illustrates satellite-detected damage and destruction at Sana'a International Airport, Sana'a Governorate, Yemen. Using satellite imagery acquired 15 May 2015 and 12 December 2014, UNITAR-UNOSAT identified a total of 70 affected structures and transportation vehicles. Approximately 18 of these were destroyed, 32 severely damaged, and 20 moderately damaged. Additionally, 32 impact craters were found. Coverage: Yemen. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
